name: admin-sso-login
title: Admin: sign in through auth.nebutra.com via SSO OIDC, keep host-only session + PlatformStaff
description: Owner decision 2026-09-08: one identity, not one cookie. Finish sso.nebutra.com login interaction against the auth.nebutra.com session, point admin's genericOAuth at it, issue admin's own host-only session, keep PlatformStaff authorisation. Cloudflare Access stays as outer door until SSO path is stable. Never accept the shared .nebutra.com tenant cookie in admin.
